comparison: Degraded and existing-text controls share clean page 1 source text. Control page 2 adds a native-text header above the image. The challenge is intentionally lower quality, not representative of every scan.

visualReview.method: All five input pages rendered with Poppler at 120 DPI and inspected individually.
visualReview.clean: Both pages have clear type, intact margins and no clipped or overlapping text.
visualReview.degraded: Deliberate blur, lower contrast, compression loss and slight rotation are visible. All source lines remain on the page.
visualReview.control: Page 1 has native text. Page 2 has a separate visible native-text header above an intact page image. No text overlaps were observed.
